sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders are in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, so they will be heavy favourites against Alsager Town, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to maintain their challenge to Sandbach after their recent draw. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two strong sides, with both teams among the division's top six. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) travel to Wednesfield Community (9th) in what could be a significant fixture for both teams' mid-table positioning. Bilston Town (6th) are away at Foley Meir (13th), while in-form Barnton (7th) host Shawbury United (15th), who have lost their last four games. New Mills (8th) travel to Market Drayton Town (10th) in a crucial fixture between mid-table sides. Crewe (16th) face Allscott Heath (11th) in a clash between struggling teams, and struggling Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) are away at Telford Town (18th) in a basement battle. Brereton Social (14th) host winless Widnes Town (20th), offering the home side a chance to climb the table against the division's lowest-ranked team.
